summary: Separated the rapidly changing voice ping from Flutter's live-region connection status so screen readers are not prompted every two seconds. Connection status remains announced; quality and ping remain separately accessible. The current app test suite, analyzer, and macOS debug build pass. Native screen-reader/runtime acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Voice status and ping use separate semantics
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/voice_connection_badge_test.dart test/voice_connection_quality_test.dart test/workspace_screen_test.dart --reporter=compact
checks.observation: Tests verify the connection state is the live region while quality/ping keeps a separate accessible label that is not a live region. The workspace fixture renders compact and regular docks.

checks.name: Flutter test suite
checks.observation: All 251 Flutter widget and unit tests passed.

checks.name: macOS debug build
checks.observation: Built build/macos/Build/Products/Debug/BOOHTACORD.app. This validates compilation, not signed release behavior or runtime session persistence.

remaining: Verify VoiceOver, NVDA and TalkBack behavior with changing ping and actual LiveKit stats on native devices. ADB reported no attached devices, and no live peer test was performed.
